title: Book Three · Chapter 19: The Missed Kick
story:
The next day, Kai puts his paper tray on his head.

“A new hat,” he says.

Ronan looks at the bent corners.

“A small head.”

Kai takes it off and leaves it in his desk. He has already eaten his lunch.

“Football today. Come with us.”

Ronan closes his lunch box. Anna is still eating. She waves him toward the door with her spoon.

Downstairs, Kai's friend waits with two other boys. They walk onto the grass and put a pair of bags several steps apart.

“That's one goal,” Kai says.

Two coats mark the other one. Ronan puts his water bottle near a bag.

They choose sides. Kai's friend points to Ronan.

“You come here.”

Ronan stands beside him. Kai takes the ball to the middle.

The game starts quickly. For a while, Ronan runs after everyone else. The ball moves before he reaches it.

Then Kai's friend sends it straight toward him.

Ronan lifts his foot. He wants one strong kick.

His shoe passes over the ball.

The ball keeps going. His foot comes down on empty grass.

Someone laughs. Ronan turns red, but he runs after it. By the time he reaches the far side, Kai has it again.

“The ball is down here,” Kai calls.

“I was kicking the wind.”

“Did you win?”

“The wind is still here.”

Kai laughs and passes the ball to his own side.

Ronan goes back to his friend. He feels warm now. There is no time to stand still and think about the missed kick.

The next pass comes more slowly. Ronan puts his foot beside the ball first. Then he pushes it toward his teammate.

The boy reaches it and runs toward the coats. His shot goes wide.

“Good pass,” he tells Ronan.

They play on. Ronan misses another ball. He stops two more and sends one back to the middle.

At the bell, nobody knows the score. One boy says three. Another says four. Kai picks up his coat.

“Count the goals tomorrow,” he says. “Class now.”

They collect their things. Ronan's bottle has fallen on its side, but the top is still tight.

Upstairs, Anna looks at the grass on his trousers.

“Did the wall play today?”

“No. The wind did.”

She waits. He tells her about the kick.

Anna laughs, and this time he does too.

Kai comes past and takes the paper tray from his desk. He puts it back on his head for one second.

“Tomorrow,” he tells Ronan. “Better shoes.”

“The shoes are fine. I need a bigger ball.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

goal＝球门、进球；kick＝踢；teammate＝队友；go wide＝偏到一边、没有射中。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次想用力踢球时发生了什么？
2. 他后来怎样成功传球？同伴有没有因为一次失误就把他排除？

## 读句子

**Two coats mark the other one.**

拆开看：Two coats / mark / the other one.

两件外套／标出／另一个球门的位置。
